message.content:
Based on my search, here is the information about typical linebacker jersey numbers:

## NFL Linebacker Jersey Numbers

**Current NFL Rules (2023 season and beyond):**
- **Linebackers can wear: 0–59 and 90–99**

This represents a significant expansion from previous rules, thanks to rule changes approved in 2021 and 2023. The 2023 change notably allowed players to wear the number 0 for the first time.

**Historical NFL Rules:**
- **1973–1984:** Linebackers wore 50–59
- **1984:** Linebackers were also allowed 90–99
- **2015:** Linebackers were allowed 40–49
- **2021:** Expanded to 1–59 and 90–99 (allowing single-digit numbers)
- **2023:** Further expanded to 0–59 and 90–99 (adding number 0)

## Traditional/Classic Linebacker Numbers

While the rules now allow more flexibility, **traditionally, linebackers are most commonly associated with:**

- **50–59** — The classic linebacker range
- **90–99** — The alternate range, particularly popular for outside linebackers and edge rushers

Numbers in the **40–49** range have also become more common for linebackers, especially after the 2015 rule change.

## College Football

College football has much more relaxed rules. While the NFL has strict position-based numbering, college players can generally wear any number from 0–99, with the only major requirement being that at least five offensive linemen must wear 50–79.

## Examples

The search results show various linebackers wearing numbers across these ranges:
- **No. 40** — A prestigious linebacker number at LSU (worn by Devin White, Harold Perkins)
- **No. 48** — Leroy Hill (Seattle Seahawks linebacker)
- **No. 57** — C.J. Mosley (Baltimore Ravens)
- **No. 91** — Some linebackers have worn this number (though more typical for defensive linemen)

Sources:
1. https://operations.nfl.com/the-rules/rules-changes/nfl-jersey-numbers/
2. https://touchdowntrips.com/nfl-jersey-numbers-explained/
3. https://www.jt-sw.com/football/pro/index.nsf/Documents/0-jers-nums
4. https://www.nfl.com/news/nfl-passes-rule-expanding-eligible-jersey-numbers
5. https://www.metroleague.org/nfl-jersey-numbers-list_af/
